question: Where can I get cadastral parcel boundaries (geometry) for all of Spain, with parcel identifier and area, as a bulk download or as a queryable service?

answer.summary: Free official GML parcel polygons (with national cadastral reference and area in m2) exist for all of Spain, but in five places: the state Cadastre (DGC) ATOM feed (7,611 municipal zips) and WFS cover everything except Navarra and the three Basque provinces; those four foral cadastres run their own ATOM/WFS, linked from the DGC ATOM index. No single national file; CRS and ID formats differ.
main_caveats: Navarra and the three Basque provinces are NOT in the DGC ATOM/WFS data; they come from four separate foral services with different CRS (4258/25830/3042) and ID schemes.
DGC WFS rejects bboxes above 1 km2 or 5,000 parcels ('Area of extension out of limits'): use ATOM for bulk. Catastro municipality codes differ from INE (Madrid 28900).
Gipuzkoa WFS and ATOM include superseded versions: 292 of 300 sampled WFS parcels had endLifespanVersion filled. Filter for it to be empty.
Licence: DGC permits own use or transformed derived products only, not redistribution of the original data; foral data is CC BY 4.0 (Navarra) or attribution (others).
DGC ATOM refreshes twice a year (feed dated 2026-08-21); WFS is live. Gipuzkoa says data is not an official map and not for certificates.
answer.confidence_reason: Every source was opened and queried this session: zips downloaded and parsed (areas checked against polygons), WFS counts and samples run; only the Sede SHP route and the commercial/academic ones are page-only.

attributes.note: Official parcel polygons are available through the state Cadastre and the four foral cadastres; schemas and access methods differ.
nationalCadastralReference: 14 chars at DGC; foral ones use other formats (Navarra 9 digits, Araba 8, Bizkaia dotted).
areaValue in m2 in every service tested (Araba WFS gives it without uom).
DGC ATOM by municipality; foral ATOM zips. No single all-Spain file.
DGC WFS limited to 1 km2 / 5,000 features per bbox; foral WFS allow count/paging.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL "https://www.catastro.hacienda.gob.es/INSPIRE/CadastralParcels/ES.SDGC.CP.atom.xml" -o cp.atom.xml ; then curl -sL "http://www.catastro.hacienda.gob.es/INSPIRE/CadastralParcels/02/ES.SDGC.CP.atom_02.xml" -o cp_02.xml ; then curl -sL "https://www.catastro.hacienda.gob.es/INSPIRE/CadastralParcels/02/02001-ABENGIBRE/A.ES.SDGC.CP.02001.zip" -o abengibre.zip
how_to_use.example_result: National feed: 56 entries (52 DGC offices + 4 foral). Province 02 feed: 87 municipal zips. A.ES.SDGC.CP.02001.zip = 1,089,149 bytes holding cadastralparcel.gml (9.4 MB, 3,837 CadastralParcel, EPSG:25830) e.g. gml:id ES.SDGC.CP.000700100XJ24B areaValue 4127 m2 (polygon area computed from coordinates 4126.6 m2).
steps: Read the national feed and list each <entry> link (rel=enclosure): 52 point to https://www.catastro.hacienda.gob.es/INSPIRE/CadastralParcels/<office>/ES.SDGC.CP.atom_<office>.xml and 4 to the foral feeds.
In each province feed take every href ending in .zip (pattern .../<office>/<code>-<NAME>/A.ES.SDGC.CP.<code>.zip) and download it; 7,611 zips in the 52 feeds.

Unzip and parse A.ES.SDGC.CP.<code>.cadastralparcel.gml (cp:CadastralParcel members): nationalCadastralReference, areaValue, geometry. Ignore cadastralzoning.gml unless urban blocks/rural polygons are wanted.
Reproject from EPSG:25830 (or 32628 for provinces 35 and 38) before merging; coordinates are x y, not lat/lon.
To get Navarra and Basque Country follow source 3.
reading_traps: Catastro municipality codes are not INE codes: Madrid is 28900-MADRID, Barcelona 08900, Sevilla 41900; Cartagena, Gijon, Jerez, Vigo are in territorial offices 51-54.
Canarias zips (provinces 35 and 38) use EPSG:32628 (tested 35001 Agaete: x 426567-435944); the rest of the peninsula tested is EPSG:25830.
Header numberMatched did not match the content in the tested file: numberMatched=3858, 3,837 CadastralParcel elements, 3,835 distinct references.
Zip size varies strongly (Abengibre 1.1 MB, Madrid 40.4 MB by headers); the full set of 7,611 zips was not downloaded.
The zip contains the whole municipality; the A. prefix is part of the file name, not a filter for urban or rural.

how_to_use.example_result: 200 text/xml, 18,641 bytes, numberMatched=8 numberReturned=8 (Albacete, Abengibre). StoredQuery GetParcel refcat=000700100XJ24B returned areaValue 4127 m2. A bbox of 11 km x 5 km returned ExceptionReport 'Area of extension out of limits'.
steps: Choose the request type: bbox (typenames=cp.cadastralparcel, bbox minx,miny,maxx,maxy in the SRS) or a stored query: STOREDQUERIE_ID=GetParcel&refcat=<14 chars>, GetParcelsByZoning&cod_zona=<code>, GetNeighbourParcel.
Keep each bbox under 1 km2 and 5,000 parcels; tile larger areas, or use source 1 for bulk.
Parse cp:CadastralParcel members; read nationalCadastralReference and areaValue.
reading_traps: With SRSname=EPSG::4258 or 4326 the coordinates came back lat lon (39.213428 -1.539039), axis order differs from EPSG:25830 x y.
The service documentation (July 2016) lists only EPSG:25830, 4326 and 4258 as examples; Canarias data are stored in 32628 unless SRS is requested.
No result paging and no SQL (the PDF says SQL queries are not admitted).

how_to_use.example_result: Navarra: numberReturned=2, references 001010001 (area 101.28 m2) and 001010002. Araba: numberMatched=223195, first parcel 64010007 areaValue 10830.82. Gipuzkoa: numberMatched=412195.
steps: For bulk, open each foral ATOM (Navarra: 341 zips; Bizkaia: 112 municipal zips; Araba: three zips by CRS; Gipuzkoa: one zip) and download the GML.
For queries use each WFS with count/startIndex paging (Navarra, Araba, Gipuzkoa tested).
Reproject to a common CRS: Navarra, Bizkaia, Gipuzkoa responses are ETRS89 lat lon (4258, axis order lat lon); Araba is 25830.
Drop Gipuzkoa parcels whose cp:endLifespanVersion is filled to keep only current parcels (tested on samples, not verified against the full set).
reading_traps: Parcel references are not DGC refcats and use four different schemes, so they cannot be joined to DGC data by identifier.
Gipuzkoa WFS: 292 of 300 parcels in a sample at startIndex 1000 had endLifespanVersion filled; ATOM zip also mostly historic in the portion read.
Navarra WFS resultType=hits returned numberMatched=20000 (looks like the CountDefault cap, not a true total).
Araba ATOM declared length 11,537,248 for the 4258 zip but the file was 126,928,543 bytes.
